title: SCTVARequest
description:
The payload the Orchestration Agent posts to the SCTVA agent's POST /sctva/execute. Assembled by backend/services/transformation_service.py::run_transformation from an ApprovedPlan.

Two things have to be gathered before the agent can run, and neither is carried by the plan on its own:

  1. SOURCE TEXT — the CUQA report describes files but never ships their contents. SCTVA's own POST /sctva/cuqa-sources reads them back out of the CUQA temp workspace, already shaped for `source_files`.
  2. ACTIONS — the plan speaks in refactoring names ('Extract Method'); SCTVA executes a fixed action vocabulary ('extract_method'). backend/domain/sctva_mapper.py performs the translation, mirroring sctva/integration/planner_adapter.py::_map_step.

This request used to be assembled in the browser. It now runs server-side, so the DIWO frontend has no direct SCTVA integration at all.

request_id.description: Correlation id, echoed back in the result.

language.description: Resolved from the workflow's language, falling back to the first source file's. SCTVA supports these three only (sctva/constants.py::SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES); anything else is refused with 422 before the agent is called.

source_files.description: The original text of every file the approved steps touch. A plan spanning ten files is not blocked by one unreadable path — files SCTVA could not locate come back in `missing` and the rest still run.

actions.description: Exactly one action per approved step, so the transformation log lines up with the plan the developer signed off on. A step that cannot be mapped becomes a `noop` carrying the reason rather than vanishing — the approved step count stays visible.

mapped_by.description: 'diwo_orchestrator' since the SCTVA call moved server-side. 'diwo_frontend' identifies requests from the older browser-side mapping.

parameters.description: Action-specific. `source_file` is always present after mapping (a step that named no file inherits the plan target). Keys the mapper had no value for are OMITTED, never sent as null — that reproduces exactly what the browser used to serialize.

source_step_id.description: The ApprovedPlan step this action came from — the link back to what the developer approved.

require_compilation.description: False because javac/gcc are not assumed to be on PATH. Syntax validation still runs.

enable_sctva_auto_refactoring.description: MUST stay false for the DIWO workflow. SCTVA defaults it to true, and whenever `source_files` is present its LocalRefactorDetector appends refactorings the plan never asked for. In a human-reviewed workflow that is a correctness bug, not a bonus: a step the developer explicitly REJECTED comes back through the side door. The approved plan is the contract; nothing else runs.
